---
title: "Exploration"
---

<style>
.exploration { max-width: 1000px; margin: 0 auto; color: #172923; }
.exploration-intro { color: #62726a; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
.exploration-card { background: #fffef9; border: 1px solid #d9ded3; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.25rem; margin: 1.25rem 0; }
.exploration-card h2 { margin-top: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #d9ded3; padding-bottom: .4rem; }
.exploration-card p, .scenario-note { color: #62726a; }
.exploration svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; touch-action: none; }
.scenario-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: end; gap: .75rem; margin: .8rem 0; }
.scenario-controls label { display: grid; gap: .2rem; color: #172923; font-size: .9rem; }
.scenario-controls input { width: 8rem; padding: .35rem; border: 1px solid #98a79b; border-radius: 4px; }
.season-cell { cursor: pointer; stroke: #fffef9; stroke-width: 2; }
.season-cell.selected { stroke: #172923; stroke-width: 3; }
.airport-node { cursor: grab; touch-action: none; }
.airport-node:active { cursor: grabbing; }
.scenario-output { font-weight: 600; color: #176b55; }
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .exploration-card { padding: .8rem; }
}
</style>

<div class="exploration">

Use the controls to sketch **hypothetical** changes to the three diagrams on the project page. These are interactive teaching visuals, not observed flight records or forecasts. Select a seasonal cell and enter a value, drag airports to rearrange the route sketch, or enter operational values to update the flow diagram.

<section class="exploration-card" aria-labelledby="seasonal-heading">
<h2 id="seasonal-heading">Seasonal pattern sketch</h2>
<p>Choose a month and measure, then enter a hypothetical value. Click or drag across the grid to select a cell.</p>
<div class="scenario-controls">
  <label>Month
    <select id="season-month">
      <option value="0">January</option><option value="1">February</option><option value="2">March</option>
      <option value="3">April</option><option value="4">May</option><option value="5">June</option>
      <option value="6">July</option><option value="7">August</option><option value="8">September</option>
      <option value="9">October</option><option value="10">November</option><option value="11">December</option>
    </select>
  </label>
  <label>Measure
    <select id="season-measure">
      <option value="0">Flight volume</option><option value="1">Departure delay</option>
      <option value="2">Arrival delay</option><option value="3">Cancellations</option>
    </select>
  </label>
  <label>Hypothetical value
    <input id="season-value" type="number" min="0" max="100" value="45">
  </label>
</div>
<svg id="season-map" viewBox="0 0 760 260" role="img" aria-label="Interactive seasonal heatmap with months and flight measures">
  <g fill="#62726a" font-size="12" font-family="sans-serif">
    <text x="10" y="58">Flights</text><text x="10" y="98">Dep. delay</text>
    <text x="10" y="138">Arr. delay</text><text x="10" y="178">Cancellations</text>
    <text x="100" y="225">Jan</text><text x="153" y="225">Feb</text><text x="206" y="225">Mar</text>
    <text x="259" y="225">Apr</text><text x="312" y="225">May</text><text x="365" y="225">Jun</text>
    <text x="418" y="225">Jul</text><text x="471" y="225">Aug</text><text x="524" y="225">Sep</text>
    <text x="577" y="225">Oct</text><text x="630" y="225">Nov</text><text x="683" y="225">Dec</text>
  </g>
  <g id="season-cells"></g>
</svg>
<p class="scenario-note">Each cell is an illustrative index from 0 to 100. Editing one cell changes only this sketch.</p>
<p id="season-output" class="scenario-output" aria-live="polite"></p>
</section>

<section class="exploration-card" aria-labelledby="route-heading">
<h2 id="route-heading">Draggable route sketch</h2>
<p>Drag any airport node. Enter a hypothetical route distance and daily flight count to change the highlighted link.</p>
<div class="scenario-controls">
  <label>SEA–ORD distance (miles)
    <input id="route-distance" type="number" min="100" max="5000" value="1721">
  </label>
  <label>Hypothetical flights per day
    <input id="route-flights" type="number" min="0" max="500" value="12">
  </label>
</div>
<svg id="route-map" viewBox="0 0 760 330" role="img" aria-label="Draggable schematic airport route network">
  <g fill="none" stroke="#cbd4c8" stroke-width="2">
    <line class="route-link" data-from="SEA" data-to="SFO"/><line class="route-link" data-from="SFO" data-to="DEN"/>
    <line class="route-link" data-from="DEN" data-to="ORD"/><line class="route-link" data-from="ORD" data-to="JFK"/>
    <line class="route-link" data-from="ORD" data-to="ATL"/><line class="route-link" data-from="DEN" data-to="DFW"/>
    <line class="route-link" data-from="DFW" data-to="ATL"/>
  </g>
  <line id="route-highlight" data-from="SEA" data-to="ORD" stroke="#e5674f" stroke-width="4"/>
  <text id="route-label" x="290" y="95" fill="#172923" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif">1,721 mi · 12 flights/day</text>
  <g class="airport-node" data-code="SEA" transform="translate(120 80)"><circle r="13" fill="#e5674f"/><text y="31" text-anchor="middle" fill="#172923" font-size="13">SEA</text></g>
  <g class="airport-node" data-code="SFO" transform="translate(270 130)"><circle r="13" fill="#e5674f"/><text y="31" text-anchor="middle" fill="#172923" font-size="13">SFO</text></g>
  <g class="airport-node" data-code="DEN" transform="translate(390 75)"><circle r="13" fill="#e7ae3b"/><text y="31" text-anchor="middle" fill="#172923" font-size="13">DEN</text></g>
  <g class="airport-node" data-code="ORD" transform="translate(500 145)"><circle r="13" fill="#e7ae3b"/><text y="31" text-anchor="middle" fill="#172923" font-size="13">ORD</text></g>
  <g class="airport-node" data-code="JFK" transform="translate(650 90)"><circle r="13" fill="#176b55"/><text y="31" text-anchor="middle" fill="#172923" font-size="13">JFK</text></g>
  <g class="airport-node" data-code="ATL" transform="translate(600 260)"><circle r="13" fill="#176b55"/><text y="31" text-anchor="middle" fill="#172923" font-size="13">ATL</text></g>
  <g class="airport-node" data-code="DFW" transform="translate(330 250)"><circle r="13" fill="#e7ae3b"/><text y="31" text-anchor="middle" fill="#172923" font-size="13">DFW</text></g>
</svg>
<p class="scenario-note">This schematic has no geographic scale. Dragging nodes changes the drawing only, not real airport coordinates.</p>
<p id="route-output" class="scenario-output" aria-live="polite"></p>
</section>

<section class="exploration-card" aria-labelledby="operation-heading">
<h2 id="operation-heading">Operational outcome sketch</h2>
<p>Enter hypothetical delay minutes and cancellation percentage to change the relative bars.</p>
<div class="scenario-controls">
  <label>Departure delay (minutes)
    <input id="departure-delay" type="number" min="0" max="600" value="20">
  </label>
  <label>Arrival delay (minutes)
    <input id="arrival-delay" type="number" min="0" max="600" value="35">
  </label>
  <label>Cancellations (percent)
    <input id="cancel-rate" type="number" min="0" max="100" value="4">
  </label>
</div>
<svg viewBox="0 0 760 210" role="img" aria-label="Hypothetical bar diagram for departure delay, arrival delay, and cancellations">
  <g fill="#62726a" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif">
    <text x="12" y="53">Departure delay</text><text x="12" y="108">Arrival delay</text><text x="12" y="163">Cancellations</text>
  </g>
  <g fill="#eef0e8">
    <rect x="160" y="32" width="500" height="24" rx="4"/><rect x="160" y="87" width="500" height="24" rx="4"/>
    <rect x="160" y="142" width="500" height="24" rx="4"/>
  </g>
  <rect id="departure-bar" x="160" y="32" width="16.7" height="24" rx="4" fill="#e7ae3b"/>
  <rect id="arrival-bar" x="160" y="87" width="29.2" height="24" rx="4" fill="#e5674f"/>
  <rect id="cancel-bar" x="160" y="142" width="20" height="24" rx="4" fill="#176b55"/>
  <g id="operation-values" fill="#172923" font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif">
    <text id="departure-label" x="670" y="50">20 min</text><text id="arrival-label" x="670" y="105">35 min</text>
    <text id="cancel-label" x="670" y="160">4%</text>
  </g>
</svg>
<p class="scenario-note">Bars are scaled to the input ranges, not to an empirical flight dataset.</p>
<p id="operation-output" class="scenario-output" aria-live="polite"></p>
</section>

</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const monthNames = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
  const measureNames = ["Flight volume", "Departure delay", "Arrival delay", "Cancellations"];
  const colors = ["#bfd75a", "#e7ae3b", "#e5674f", "#176b55"];
  const cellValues = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, row) =>
    Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, month) => 28 + ((month * 13 + row * 19) % 65))
  );
  const cellGroup = document.getElementById("season-cells");
  const monthInput = document.getElementById("season-month");
  const measureInput = document.getElementById("season-measure");
  const valueInput = document.getElementById("season-value");
  const seasonOutput = document.getElementById("season-output");
  let selectedCell;

  cellValues.forEach((row, rowIndex) => row.forEach((value, monthIndex) => {
    const cell = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "rect");
    cell.setAttribute("x", 92 + monthIndex * 53);
    cell.setAttribute("y", 34 + rowIndex * 40);
    cell.setAttribute("width", 48);
    cell.setAttribute("height", 32);
    cell.setAttribute("rx", 4);
    cell.setAttribute("class", "season-cell");
    cell.dataset.month = monthIndex;
    cell.dataset.measure = rowIndex;
    cellGroup.append(cell);
    cell.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => selectCell(cell));
    cell.addEventListener("pointerenter", (event) => {
      if (event.buttons === 1) selectCell(cell);
    });
  }));

  function colorFor(value, row) {
    const opacity = 0.2 + (value / 100) * 0.8;
    return `${colors[row]}${Math.round(opacity * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  }

  function paintCell(cell) {
    const month = Number(cell.dataset.month);
    const row = Number(cell.dataset.measure);
    cellValues[row][month] = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(valueInput.value) || 0));
    cell.setAttribute("fill", colorFor(cellValues[row][month], row));
    seasonOutput.textContent = `${monthNames[month]} · ${measureNames[row]}: hypothetical index ${cellValues[row][month]}/100.`;
  }

  function selectCell(cell) {
    selectedCell?.classList.remove("selected");
    selectedCell = cell;
    selectedCell.classList.add("selected");
    monthInput.value = cell.dataset.month;
    measureInput.value = cell.dataset.measure;
    valueInput.value = cellValues[Number(cell.dataset.measure)][Number(cell.dataset.month)];
    paintCell(cell);
  }

  cellGroup.querySelectorAll(".season-cell").forEach((cell) => {
    cell.setAttribute("fill", colorFor(cellValues[Number(cell.dataset.measure)][Number(cell.dataset.month)], Number(cell.dataset.measure)));
  });
  function selectFromInputs() {
    selectCell(cellGroup.querySelector(`[data-month="${monthInput.value}"][data-measure="${measureInput.value}"]`));
  }
  monthInput.addEventListener("change", selectFromInputs);
  measureInput.addEventListener("change", selectFromInputs);
  valueInput.addEventListener("input", () => selectedCell && paintCell(selectedCell));
  selectFromInputs();

  const routeSvg = document.getElementById("route-map");
  const routeLine = document.getElementById("route-highlight");
  const routeLabel = document.getElementById("route-label");
  const routeDistance = document.getElementById("route-distance");
  const routeFlights = document.getElementById("route-flights");
  const routeOutput = document.getElementById("route-output");
  const nodes = new Map([...routeSvg.querySelectorAll(".airport-node")].map((node) => [node.dataset.code, node]));
  let activeNode;

  function nodePosition(node) {
    const match = node.getAttribute("transform").match(/translate\(([-\d.]+)\s+([-\d.]+)\)/);
    return { x: Number(match[1]), y: Number(match[2]) };
  }
  function updateRoute() {
    const sea = nodePosition(nodes.get("SEA"));
    const ord = nodePosition(nodes.get("ORD"));
    const distance = Math.max(100, Math.min(5000, Number(routeDistance.value) || 100));
    const flights = Math.max(0, Math.min(500, Number(routeFlights.value) || 0));
    routeDistance.value = distance;
    routeFlights.value = flights;
    routeSvg.querySelectorAll("[data-from][data-to]").forEach((line) => {
      const start = nodePosition(nodes.get(line.dataset.from));
      const end = nodePosition(nodes.get(line.dataset.to));
      line.setAttribute("x1", start.x);
      line.setAttribute("y1", start.y);
      line.setAttribute("x2", end.x);
      line.setAttribute("y2", end.y);
    });
    routeLine.setAttribute("stroke-width", 2 + Math.min(flights, 100) / 10);
    routeLabel.setAttribute("x", (sea.x + ord.x) / 2);
    routeLabel.setAttribute("y", (sea.y + ord.y) / 2 - 12);
    routeLabel.textContent = `${distance.toLocaleString()} mi · ${flights} flights/day`;
    routeOutput.textContent = `Hypothetical SEA–ORD route: ${distance.toLocaleString()} miles and ${flights} flights per day.`;
  }
  function moveNode(event) {
    if (!activeNode) return;
    const point = routeSvg.createSVGPoint();
    point.x = event.clientX;
    point.y = event.clientY;
    const local = point.matrixTransform(routeSvg.getScreenCTM().inverse());
    const x = Math.max(30, Math.min(730, local.x));
    const y = Math.max(30, Math.min(300, local.y));
    activeNode.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${x} ${y})`);
    updateRoute();
  }
  routeSvg.querySelectorAll(".airport-node").forEach((node) => {
    node.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
      activeNode = node;
      node.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    });
    node.addEventListener("pointermove", moveNode);
    node.addEventListener("pointerup", () => { activeNode = null; });
    node.addEventListener("pointercancel", () => { activeNode = null; });
  });
  routeDistance.addEventListener("input", updateRoute);
  routeFlights.addEventListener("input", updateRoute);
  updateRoute();

  const operationInputs = [
    { input: "departure-delay", bar: "departure-bar", label: "departure-label", suffix: " min", scale: 600 },
    { input: "arrival-delay", bar: "arrival-bar", label: "arrival-label", suffix: " min", scale: 600 },
    { input: "cancel-rate", bar: "cancel-bar", label: "cancel-label", suffix: "%", scale: 100 }
  ];
  function updateOperations() {
    operationInputs.forEach(({ input, bar, label, suffix, scale }) => {
      const field = document.getElementById(input);
      const value = Math.max(0, Math.min(scale, Number(field.value) || 0));
      field.value = value;
      document.getElementById(bar).setAttribute("width", (500 * value / scale).toFixed(1));
      document.getElementById(label).textContent = `${value}${suffix}`;
    });
    document.getElementById("operation-output").textContent =
      `Hypothetical delays: ${document.getElementById("departure-delay").value} minutes departing and ${document.getElementById("arrival-delay").value} minutes arriving; cancellation rate ${document.getElementById("cancel-rate").value}%.`;
  }
  operationInputs.forEach(({ input }) => document.getElementById(input).addEventListener("input", updateOperations));
  updateOperations();
})();
</script>
